summary: Pink-themed "Get Well Soon" gift webpage for Yashi; deployment/publish flow now includes an Internet Computer-style backend canister where backend/main.mo must define a minimal actor interface (health-check) so the frontend build pipeline (useActor.ts) can generate/use the Candid interface successfully.
architectural_notes: Deliver as a single self-contained index.html with embedded CSS and JavaScript.
Only external dependency allowed: Google Fonts (optionally lightweight CDN animation assets if needed).
Persist the entered wish using localStorage so it survives refresh.
Design must be fully responsive and touch-friendly for mobile/desktop.

If using a backend canister, backend/main.mo must not be empty; it must define an actor interface (e.g., a simple getHealth() query) so the Candid interface can be generated/consumed by the frontend build pipeline (useActor.ts).
known_issues: Publish/deployment failing with configuration error because backend/main.mo is empty while the frontend build pipeline (useActor.ts) expects a valid actor/Candid interface.
Publish blocked by domain validation: domain must be 5–50 characters and contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens (previous domain "Cutie_Pie" invalid due to underscore).

existing_features.title: Create a single-page, mobile-first React UI that visually matches a cute pastel-pink “Get Well Soon” gift site dedicated to Yashi, including a cozy background (clouds/blanket-like gradient), hearts/flowers motif, gentle sparkles, and consistently applied playful typography using Google Fonts (e.g., Fredoka One + Poppins).

Implement the hero section with prominent headline text exactly: “Hey Yashi, CutiePie 🌸 Sending you all the hugs!💕” and add an animated “hearts raining down” effect that feels gentle (non-distracting), performs smoothly on mobile, and respects reduced-motion preferences.

Add a “caring messages” section containing the message exactly: “Rest up, eat chocolate, binge your faves. I've got you! 😘” and display three cute icons (chocolate, teddy bear, hot water bottle) alongside the message using lightweight inline SVG/CSS (no heavy icon dependencies).

Create an interactive center “3D-style” pink gift box with ribbon and bow. On hover (desktop) and on tap/click (mobile), animate the box opening with a smooth flip/unfold animation and trigger a confetti burst from inside the box.

When the gift box is open, reveal the text exactly: “Congratulations Yashi! 🎉✨ You have got ONE WISH to ask! MY LADY? 💖”, followed by a glowing wish input field and a “Send Wish” button. The input must be touch-friendly, clearly legible, and visually styled to match the theme.

On “Send Wish”, trigger a lightweight fireworks animation (e.g., canvas-based particles) and display the response message exactly: “Your wish is my command! I'll make it happen ASAP ! 🥰”. Persist the wish in localStorage and restore it on refresh (including restoring the input value and a visible indication that a wish was saved).

Ensure the page is fully responsive and fast-loading: optimize animations for performance, avoid heavy external dependencies (no third-party libraries except Google Fonts), and ensure touch targets are appropriately sized for mobile users.
Add the footer text exactly: “This is [Herryn] ❤️ Feb 2026” and style it to match the overall cute pastel theme without distracting from the main interactions.
Update the project/app domain name to "Cutiepie" (letters only; 5–50 characters; no underscores) and rerun the publish/deployment so the site is published successfully under that domain.

new_feature_requests.summary: Build a complete single-file HTML (embedded CSS/JS) pink pastel "Get Well Soon" gift site for Yashi featuring animated hero with raining hearts, caring message section with cute icons, interactive 3D-style gift box that opens with confetti to reveal a wish input + Send button triggering fireworks and storing wish in localStorage, fully responsive/touch-friendly, Google Fonts, and footer signature/date.
Fix publish configuration error by replacing backend/main.mo with a minimal Motoko actor exposing a query getHealth() function so a valid Candid interface is generated for the frontend (useActor.ts).

Replace the entire contents of backend/main.mo with the provided Motoko actor that exposes a public query getHealth() : async Text returning "System Operational", so the canister compiles and a valid Candid interface is generated for the frontend actor typing (used by frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts).
Update the project/app domain name to "Cutiepie" (to satisfy domain validation rules) and rerun the publish/deployment.

projectName: Cute pink “Get Well Soon” gift page for Yashi with animated hearts and interactive wish gift box
